lines.text: The LORD calls the islands to be silent, and says He is the first and the last.
The islands see and fear, and the craftsman encourages the goldsmith, saying of the welding, "It is good."
The LORD calls Israel His servant, a descendant of Abraham His shepherd, and tells them not to fear.
The LORD tells Israel not to fear, calls Abraham their Redeemer, and makes them a new, sharp sledge.
The LORD will open rivers on the barren heights and plant cedars in the wilderness, so all will know.
